# 100 USD bought with CAD at 1.35, by a transaction with no description.
#
# What this fixture produces: Assets:Bank:USD holding 100.00 USD whose cost
# basis is 1.35 CAD, from a transaction whose header states a date and nothing
# else.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_fx_balances_lists_a_cost_basis_with_no_description.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-01-10 *
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "135.00"
	Assets:Bank -135.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-135.00"
